descripcion_geo: Region on the eastern coast of the Adriatic (present-day Albania and former Yugoslavia). Paul came there on his European mission.

historias.descripcion: Paul describes the scope of its mission: from Jerusalem to Illyria, on the Adriatic coast.
Titus was sent to Dalmatia (part of Illyria) in the final ministry of Paul.

historias.titulo: Illyria: western limit of the Pauline mission
historias.descripcion: Illyria was the westernmost point reached by Paul before his final journey to Rome.

personajes.descripcion: He came preaching the gospel to Illyria on the shore of the Adriatic.
He was sent to Dalmatia (Illyria) in the last stage of the Pauline ministry.
Companion of Paul who recorded his missionary trips.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Illyria: relevant region in the NT world.

cristianismo.descripcion: Paul described the full arc of his mission: from Jerusalem to Illyria, fulfilling the mandate to take the gospel to the ends of the earth.
